csv_project_name: A/E for Combined Parks and Recreation Senior Center
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Camden ( Owner ) is Requesting Qualifications ( RFQs ) from qualified architectural, engineering, and planning firms to provide professional design and related consulting services for the development of a new Combined Parks and Recreation Senior Center including a gymnasium and associated recreational amenities. The Owner intends to develop a modern, multi-purpose facility designed to support senior programming, community recreation, wellness activities, youth and adult athletics, and public events. The proposed project may include, but is not limited to, the following components: Facility Components Senior Center programming areas Parks and Recreation administrative offices Multi-purpose meeting and activity rooms Community event space Commercial or warming kitchen Fitness and wellness areas Arts and crafts rooms Computer/technology classroom Lounge and social spaces Public restrooms Private three piece staff bathroom Storage and support areas Gymnasium Components Full-size gymnasium or multi-court athletic facility Basketball and volleyball capability Bleachers/seating Athletic storage Scoreboards and sports equipment systems Walking track (optional) Support space Site Improvements Parking facilities Sidewalks and pedestrian circulation Outdoor passive amenities Landscaping and green space Stormwater infrastructure Site lighting and signage
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Cost Estimating, Inspection Services, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: A/E for Combined Parks and Recreation Senior Center
short_description: Design services for a new multi-purpose senior center with gymnasium and site amenities.
project_scope: New combined Parks and Recreation Senior Center in Camden, North Carolina. Planned components include senior center programming areas, parks and recreation administrative offices, multi-purpose meeting and activity rooms, community event space, commercial or warming kitchen, fitness and wellness areas, arts and crafts rooms, computer/technology classroom, lounge and social spaces, public restrooms, private three-piece staff bathroom, storage and support areas. Gymnasium components include a full-size gymnasium or multi-court athletic facility with basketball and volleyball capability, bleachers/seating, athletic storage, scoreboards and sports equipment systems, and an optional walking track. Site improvements include parking, sidewalks and pedestrian circulation, outdoor passive amenities, landscaping and green space, stormwater infrastructure, site lighting, and signage. No gross floor area or dimensions are stated.
services: RFQ for professional design and related consulting services including architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, cost estimating, inspection services, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Multi-purpose public building with gymnasium, which can involve moderate-span roof and structural design.
- Structural engineering is explicitly requested, offering a potential entry point for sbp.
- Sports/recreation component increases interest compared with a standard administrative building.
- However, no unusual structural system, long span, iconic architecture, or major technical complexity is described.
- Broad A/E-led procurement suggests sbp would more likely participate as a specialist subconsultant than prime consultant.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Useful scope indicators: new senior center and recreation facility with full-size gymnasium or multi-court athletic facility, support spaces, kitchen, offices, meeting rooms, fitness areas, and full site development including parking, stormwater, lighting, and landscaping. A rough order-of-magnitude for such a project could plausibly fall in the low tens of millions of USD, but the documents provide no reliable basis for a defensible estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. Structural scope likely relates to the building and gymnasium roof structure plus coordination with civil/site works, but there is no stated construction budget, fee schedule, or service phase breakdown to support a realistic fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Qualified architectural, engineering, and planning firms are requested. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects, fee zones, or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided source.
contracting_authority: Camden County, Camden, North Carolina, USA. Contact: Erin Burke. Phone: 252-338-1919. Fax: 252-333-1603. Email: eburke@camdencountync.gov. Website: https://www.camdencountync.gov/bids.aspx?bidID=4
notes: Procurement stage is RFQ/RFP. Questions deadline: 07/22/2026 05:00 PM EDT. The notice emphasizes a combined senior center and recreation facility rather than a pure sports venue; category selected as Sports due to the gymnasium and athletic program. No area, span, sustainability targets, or delivery method are stated.
